pages.title: Our story
pages.body:
Thar Nectar began with a simple promise: let the land lead. We work alongside beekeepers who know every bloom, every season, and the quiet work that makes a truly good jar of honey.

Our hives move with the wildflowers. Every batch is harvested in small quantities, gently strained, and left just as nature made it. No heat, no blending, no shortcuts.

From our family to your table, thank you for making room for a little sweetness.
pages.metaDescription: The people and place behind every jar of Thar Nectar.

pages.title: Shipping & returns
pages.body:
We pack each order with care and ship across Pakistan. Orders are usually dispatched within two working days, with delivery in 3–5 working days depending on your location.

Shipping is PKR 250, and complimentary on orders of PKR 5,000 or more. You will receive a message when your parcel is on the way.

If a jar arrives damaged, please contact us within 48 hours with your order number and a photo. We will make it right with a replacement or refund.
